summary: A minimal CLI + library package that builds schema-introspection URL paths and exposes typed config primitives, laying the groundwork for a typed-client code-generation workflow against Barkpark's /v1/schemas API.

intentions.title: Provide type-safe developer config for codegen
intentions.evidence: types.ts defines BarkparkCodegenConfig (input/output/workspace/project) and the defineConfig() identity helper in index.ts exists solely to give IDE autocomplete and TypeScript checking in barkpark.config.ts files

intentions.title: Abstract multi-tenancy routing (workspace/project scoping) from consumers
intentions.evidence: schema-url.ts buildSchemaPath() centralises the /w/<workspace>/p/<project>/v1/schemas/<dataset> vs flat /v1/schemas/<dataset> path selection, preserving back-compat for existing single-tenant users while enabling scoped multi-tenant access

intentions.title: Enable automated TypeScript type generation from live Barkpark schemas
intentions.evidence: cli.ts schema-path command prints the introspection URL for a dataset so external tooling (e.g. graphql-codegen or custom scripts) can fetch the schema JSON and emit typed clients; BarkparkSchemaJson type in types.ts models the /v1/schemas/:dataset response shape

intentions.title: Reach peak DX — zero-config typed API client for JS consumers
intentions.evidence: defineConfig helper, the codegen package's position in the JS SDK monorepo alongside @barkpark/core and @barkpark/nextjs, and the README-level 'not-built boundary' note in js/CLAUDE.md all point to this as the scaffold for a future generate-once, type-safe query layer
